evals.description: Basic hygiene run: resolves stale entries, compacts append-only files with duplicates, merges overflow.mem, regenerates .plan.md files. Validates deduplication logic and backup creation.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-review-0/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-review-0/.memplan/decisions && cd /tmp/eval-review-0 && git init && printf 'dep:plan.mem=checkpoint.mem
' > .memplan/deps.mem && printf 'plan.mem:checkpoint.mem
' > .memplan/deps-closure.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T10:00Z +stale:file=plan.mem,because=checkpoint.mem,session=~2026-05-28
~2026-05-28T10:05Z +stale:file=facts.mem,because=new-facts,session=~2026-05-28
' > .memplan/stale.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +entity:name=User,kind=class,context=src/user.ts
~2026-05-28T09:05Z +entity:name=Order,kind=class,context=src/order.ts
~2026-05-28T09:10Z +entity:name=User,kind=class,context=src/user.ts
' > .memplan/memory/entities.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +fact:tag=db,text=use-postgres
~2026-05-28T09:05Z +fact:tag=db,text=no-mocks
~2026-05-28T09:10Z +fact:tag=db,text=use-postgres
' > .memplan/memory/facts.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +touched:file=src/api.ts,purpose=add-endpoint
~2026-05-28T09:05Z +touched:file=src/api.ts,purpose=add-endpoint
' > .memplan/memory/code-map.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +failure:cmd=npm-test,reason=missing-env
~2026-05-28T09:05Z +failure:cmd=npm-test,reason=missing-env
' > .memplan/memory/failures.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +question:text=should-use-redis
~2026-05-28T09:05Z +question:text=should-use-redis
' > .memplan/memory/questions.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +decision:choice=postgres,because=team-standard
~2026-05-28T09:05Z +decision:choice=postgres,because=team-standard
' > .memplan/decisions/log.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +entity:name=Product,kind=class,context=src/product.ts
~2026-05-28T09:05Z +fact:tag=api,text=rest-only
~2026-05-28T09:10Z +touched:file=src/db.ts,purpose=add-migration
' > .memplan/memory/overflow.mem && printf 'last-action:updated-checkpoint
' > .memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf 'title:test-plan
' > .memplan/plan.mem && git add .memplan && git commit -m 'initial state'
evals.expected_output: Stale entries resolved (plan.mem, facts.mem). Duplicate entries removed from all append-only files (entities.mem, facts.mem, code-map.mem, failures.mem, questions.mem, decisions/log.mem). Overflow.mem entries merged into target files. All .plan.md files regenerated. Backup files created with .backup extension. Summary printed with line counts.

assertions.text: stale.mem contains +stale-resolved entries for plan.mem and facts.mem
entities.mem contains 2 entries (User and Order), duplicate User removed
facts.mem contains 2 entries (use-postgres and no-mocks), duplicate use-postgres removed
code-map.mem contains 1 entry (src/api.ts), duplicate removed
failures.mem contains 1 entry (npm-test), duplicate removed
questions.mem contains 1 entry (should-use-redis), duplicate removed
decisions/log.mem contains 1 entry (postgres), duplicate removed
overflow.mem entries merged into entities.mem, facts.mem, and code-map.mem; overflow.mem deleted or emptied
.backup files exist for all modified files
All .plan.md files exist and are locked read-only

evals.description: Empty stale list: skill skips Phase 2 (resolve stale entries) and proceeds directly to compaction. Validates graceful handling of no-work scenario.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-review-1/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-review-1/.memplan/decisions && cd /tmp/eval-review-1 && git init && printf '' > .memplan/stale.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +entity:name=User,kind=class,context=src/user.ts
' > .memplan/memory/entities.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +fact:tag=db,text=use-postgres
' > .memplan/memory/facts.mem && printf '' > .memplan/memory/code-map.mem && printf '' > .memplan/memory/failures.mem && printf '' > .memplan/memory/questions.mem && printf '' > .memplan/decisions/log.mem && printf 'last-action:none
' > .memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf 'title:test-plan
' > .memplan/plan.mem && git add .memplan && git commit -m 'initial state'
evals.expected_output: Skill reports 'No stale entries to resolve' and proceeds to compaction. No duplicates found (single entry in each file). All .plan.md files regenerated. Summary shows 0 resolved stale entries.

assertions.text: Skill reports 0 stale entries to resolve
Compaction reports 'no duplicates' for all files
All .plan.md files regenerated despite no changes to .mem files

evals.description: Unresolved stale entries: skill resolves some entries but leaves others unresolved. Validates selective resolution and correct rewriting of stale.mem.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-review-2/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-review-2/.memplan/decisions && cd /tmp/eval-review-2 && git init && printf 'dep:plan.mem=checkpoint.mem
dep:risk.mem=failures.mem
' > .memplan/deps.mem && printf 'plan.mem:checkpoint.mem
risk.mem:failures.mem
' > .memplan/deps-closure.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T10:00Z +stale:file=plan.mem,because=checkpoint.mem,session=~2026-05-28
~2026-05-28T10:05Z +stale:file=risk.mem,because=failures.mem,session=~2026-05-28
' > .memplan/stale.mem && printf 'last-action:plan-updated
' > .memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf 'title:test-plan
' > .memplan/plan.mem && printf 'what-could-break:data-loss
' > .memplan/risk.mem && printf '~2026-05-28T09:00Z +failure:cmd=git-push,reason=no-auth
' > .memplan/memory/failures.mem && printf '' > .memplan/memory/entities.mem && printf '' > .memplan/memory/facts.mem && printf '' > .memplan/memory/code-map.mem && printf '' > .memplan/memory/questions.mem && printf '' > .memplan/decisions/log.mem && git add .memplan && git commit -m 'initial state'
evals.expected_output: plan.mem stale entry resolved (checkpoint is stable). risk.mem remains stale (failures.mem still has unresolved failures). stale.mem rewritten to contain only unresolved entries. Summary shows 1 resolved, 1 unresolved.

assertions.text: stale.mem contains +stale-resolved for plan.mem but NOT for risk.mem
stale.mem rewritten to retain only unresolved entry for risk.mem
Summary reports 1 resolved stale entry and 1 unresolved
